description: This file defines constants, types, and functions for configuring and managing Gmail hooks within a larger application, including token generation, path normalization, configuration resolution, and command argument building.

methods.name: generateHookToken
methods.description: Generates a random hexadecimal token of specified byte length.

methods.name: mergeHookPresets
methods.description: Merges existing hook presets with a new preset, ensuring no duplicates.

methods.name: normalizeHooksPath
methods.description: Normalizes a hooks path, ensuring it starts with '/' and does not end with '/'.

methods.name: normalizeServePath
methods.description: Normalizes a serve path, ensuring it starts with '/' and does not end with '/'.

methods.name: buildDefaultHookUrl
methods.description: Builds a default hook URL based on hooks path and port.

methods.name: resolveGmailHookRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Resolves and validates the Gmail hook runtime configuration based on provided config and overrides.

methods.name: buildGogWatchStartArgs
methods.description: Builds command-line arguments to start the Gmail watch process.

methods.name: buildGogWatchServeArgs
methods.description: Builds command-line arguments to serve the Gmail watch.

methods.name: buildTopicPath
methods.description: Constructs a Google Cloud Pub/Sub topic path.

methods.name: parseTopicPath
methods.description: Parses a Pub/Sub topic path into project ID and topic name.
